title: P4_7 revision 2026-10-26: who may publish what to whom — registered surfaces, honest statuses and evaluator redlines

surfaces.question: who may publish project knowledge into the LLMWiki (Kp)
surfaces.surface: project-internal stdio MCP over the registered canonical wiki root .sdd/wiki/sdd-harness
surfaces.externalAuthorization: NOT_REQUIRED — no external principal/tenant/audience is involved; the boundary is containment + tier policy, registered against the committed llmwiki domain policies (project-root-policy / index-policy / mcp-profile)
unverified: canonical root not yet initialized on this host (project-root-policy revisionVerification.canonicalRootPresentOnHost=false)
hooks.yaml kb-write-protection does not cover the canonical landing path (controlPlaneHookGap, recorded for the control-plane owner)
Kp admission/closeout judgment belongs to the Comet gate (P4_4); the reserved curated-write admission ref grants nothing by itself

surfaces.question: who may publish team knowledge to the Outline managed collection (Kt)
requiredEntries: source-permission-readback (gh TLS x509; ledger disclosureAudience empty)
publisher-credential-materialization (ref is catalog shape only; consumed owner key may not be reused)
fresh-outbound-authorization (14 old + 15 new one-time consensus authorizations all consumed)
surfaces.p44Rule: P4_4 may exercise decide/recheck over fixture worlds, but no live Outline publish may be claimed while any entry is NOT_PROVISIONED; an ungrounded NOT_PROVISIONED->PROVISIONED flip is KT_GRANT_CLAIM_UNGROUNDED

dimensions.completeAudience: HISTORICAL_PARTIAL (2026-10-22 readback preserved; attachment never READ; current revision observed loopback reachability only)
dimensions.grantValidity: STRUCTURAL_ONLY (grants structurally valid to 2027-01-18; issuanceCredential UNREGISTERED — not live authorizations)
dimensions.version: STRUCTURAL_ONLY (payload-digest + decisionId binding evaluator-enforced; no live payload yet)

preauthorizedCollectionDomain.rule: no dimension may be upgraded from UNVERIFIED/STRUCTURAL_ONLY to a live claim without evidence; the committed decide fails closed

negativeRedlines.redline: no one can mutate the permission policy through this surface
evaluatorAssertions: POLICY_MUTATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED (authorize-policy-change refuses every principal incl. the registered owner; mutated: []; trusted artifacts change only as a new version through the protected issuance path)
REDLINE_WEAKENED (flipping/removing a redline flag in policy or surface fails validate)

negativeRedlines.redline: an owner key copied from the database never travels in a request
evaluatorAssertions: SECRET_MATERIAL_IN_REQUEST (key-shaped fields and token-shaped values in publish requests are refused; credentials only cross the I01 ref gate)
CONSUMED_AUTHORIZATION_RECORD_INVALID (re-flagging a consumed one-shot authorization as reusable fails validate)

consumedAuthorizations: outline-owner-key-three-api-readonly (consumed; no re-run, no value read, no repurposing as Publisher/Isolator/issuer)

currentRevisionObservation.scope: credential-free loopback reachability only (mirrors I03-comet-050); reachability is NOT publish permission and NOT audience/grant/action authority

verdictSemantics.PASS: the surfaces are registered with honest statuses, the redlines hold under the evaluator's negative probes, and the adjacent regressions stay green
verdictSemantics.UNVERIFIED: live source/target permission readback, attachment channel, protected issuance workflow, publisher credential materialization and a fresh outbound authorization are all UNVERIFIED/NOT_PROVISIONED — recorded honestly, never converted to PASS
